rachel: Dropping a new comp — compact action pills that attach to the trailing edge of a streaming message: Stop | Pause | Regenerate. Intent is minimal visual noise but high discoverability when reading. Link: https://figma.redwood/playground/attach-pills ben: I like the trailing attachment. Two quick product asks: 1) Pause should allow reading without canceling the LLM context, 2) Stopping should cancel the request and surface partial text as read-only. tia: Concern: Pause semantics are tricky for the runtime. Pause = buffer tokens client-side and resume playback? That couples UI with streaming implementation. Maybe we implement Pause as a UX-only affordance that halts rendering, but still streams under the hood (so we don't break model state). sam: Token + cost idea: show tiny muted text under the message: "24 tokens • ~$0.0024". When regen changes usage show a delta pill: "+5 tokens" (green) or "-3 tokens" (muted). This gives authors immediate signal about cost. rachel: Good — can we also show an estimated time-to-finish when streaming (e.g., "~1.2s remaining")? Helps users decide whether to stop. Keep it optional and toggleable in prefs. ux-bot: Analytics suggestion: playground.ui.action.press, playground.ui.token.preview, playground.ui.stream.pause, playground.ui.stream.stop. Confirm events and properties (response_id, token_count_delta, user_prefers_reduced_motion). ben: Accessibility: must ensure keyboard reachability and clear announcements. Proposed keyboard map: Esc => Stop (when focus is in message actions), Shift+Esc => Pause/Resume, Cmd/Ctrl+R => Regenerate (when message actions focused). Need explicit focus visuals for the pill row. tia: For screen readers use aria-live="polite" on the streaming container, and an offscreen visually-hidden status for pause/stop/regenerate announcements. Example: ```html
…partial tokens…
24 tokens • $0.0024
``` sam: UI nit: token microcopy should be 12px/line-height 16 and weight 400 — subtle. Also color tokens in a single neutral color, only color-delta for +/-. rachel: Motion accessibility: follow prefers-reduced-motion (no shimmer) and reduce rapid layout shifts when tokens arrive. CSS snippet: ```css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .stream-shimmer { animation: none; opacity: 0.95; } } ``` ben: Prompt library placement debate: bottom sheet (mobile-first) vs right slide-over (desktop). I vote right slide-over on desktop but keep a bottom sheet behavior on small viewports. Consistency with other panels matters. Also allow keyboard "p" to open quick prompt palette. tia: Implementation detail: if prompt library inserts a snippet while a stream is active we should auto-pause streaming and lower focus into the editor to prevent accidental overwrite. UI should confirm insert with inline toast: "Inserted prompt: X — Stream paused." sam: Edge case: multiple simultaneous streams (split view) — controls should be per-stream with unique IDs and analytics must include stream_index. Also ensure regenerate targets the correct response id. rachel: Action list: - Design: finalize pill spacing, hit target, microcopy for token/cost/ETA (rachel) - Dev: implement keyboard mapping + focus ring + pause rendering (ben, tia) - Accessibility: aria-live & offscreen confirmations + test with VoiceOver/NVDA (tia) - Analytics: confirm event names and token delta props (sam / ux-bot) sam: I'll draft the analytics schema and sample payloads. rachel: Cool — if no objections I'll mark comp as "ready for engineering" and create ticket UI-PL-8011. :thumbsup: tia: :+1: starting spike on pause-vs-render PR tomorrow. ux-bot: Created ticket UI-PL-8011 (playground: trailing action pills, per-response token+cost, responsive prompt library).
